objective: Implement deterministic hard asset and strategy limits over candidate risk and position counts without portfolio-correlation, leverage, execution or broker authority.
scope: Require explicit ASSET and STRATEGY limit rules
Require explicit current usage for every evaluated rule
Consume only upstream SIZE_CANDIDATE position-sizing decisions
Enforce maximum risk utilization in basis points for asset and strategy scopes
Enforce maximum open-position counts for asset and strategy scopes
Fail closed when required rules or usage are missing
Provide deterministic decision identity and reason codes
tests: Missing asset or strategy rule fails closed
Risk utilization above asset limit vetoes
Risk utilization above strategy limit vetoes
Open-position count above asset limit vetoes
Open-position count above strategy limit vetoes
No portfolio, leverage or execution authority is emitted
P15-C evidence is byte-identical across two runs
security_tests: A5 limit ceilings are immutable during evaluation
rollback: Revert P15-C module/config/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P15-B remains canonical complete and P15-D remains unstarted.
definition_of_ready: No active governed task or lock conflict
definition_of_done: Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
